## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed v2.3.1 unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy in production, while v2.3.1 (and its staging RC) were unhealthy. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback (on-call paged).
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east only, halted by an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.

**Final state (verified):**
- All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on **v2.3.0**
- Service is **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002

The incident INC-0001 remains open for the on-call engineer to follow up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
